restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 6423f959, 7e640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 42 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_42(M(x))) XOR q with published q=7206212b1fab9ca403729156e26291fd250292b6a2a549d7c1a02881a49e3310. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=3064. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181911955731759 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 47.10004.
Peak memory is 1048573 bytes; setup peaks at 616374 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 9f6412775067d0494dbba1ebc3ac6f7b9adbf25aa31ec429704591ae125f55a4; stripped wasm SHA-256 366263a8bb4a3111eb822c941b5d99bf41449b834605cb16a81398eda10bc1e5; emitted SLP SHA-256 854903c3a5590024d8fbb49487cd3895d5541c675abd861516caa51b8afc4d92. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.
Credited derivative of 1a13d615-11f4-4091-94b1-fa4331ae49b1, d22ae1b2-2368-460a-b6d4-1e5e37ceb735, 95263e47-d61b-43a6-bb46-30ced2488280, and their same-challenge lineage.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r42-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
